title: USACE continues its Hurricane Ida recovery, one roof at a time
description: William Brigance, a U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Nashville District lock and dam equipment mechanic and mobile command vehicle support specialist, discusses the USACE Blue Roof mission and what it means to him to support the Hurricane Ida response efforts in Louisiana.
unit_name: U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, St. Paul District
